result.summary: Reviewed only the test_ledger.py delta from 311ad9e54d5531d482be12974e497c73077dbcf4 to 51fb6147b6883f7e6096f6f855723c64cbd19eaf. The prior infinite polling loop is replaced by a 5000-iteration bound plus a timed join and explicit completion checks. Worker BaseException instances are captured and asserted in the test thread. One nonblocking robustness gap remains: snapshots starts at 1 for the snapshot taken immediately after the barrier, before there is any guarantee the worker has begun its transfer loop. The worker can finish before the polling loop observes it, so assertGreater(snapshots, 0) does not ensure any snapshot was taken during active transfers. No other regression found in the scoped delta. Supplied checks were not rerun.

findings.summary: Snapshot counter is initialized to 1 for the pre-poll snapshot, so the test can pass without sampling during the worker's transfers if it completes before polling.
